analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 36.7로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램은 -123.4003으로 개선되었으나 여전히 음수 구간. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.95로 정상 수준. 하락 추세 지속 및 약세 국면 진입으로 판단. 23,720원 스윙 지지선 하향 돌파 시 추가 하락 가능성.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI entered oversold territory at 36.7, and while the MACD histogram improved to -123.4003, it remains in negative territory. Volume ratio at 0.95, indicating normal levels. Judged to be continuing the downtrend and entering a weak phase. Potential for further decline if the 23,720 won swing support is breached.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (24,715 KRW) below SMA5 (26,639 KRW), SMA20 (28,385 KRW), SMA50 (32,873 KRW): diagnosing short- to mid-term trend in weak position.
· Below SMA100 (35,259 KRW), SMA200 (36,501 KRW): indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (19.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.1 → 36.7): entering oversold territory, continuing decline.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1998.6079 → -123.4003): improving but still negative, signaling continued weakness.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 23,670 KRW): approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (23,720 KRW): based on 5-day/20-day lows.
· Swing resistance (30,570 KRW): potential for short-term bounce if breached.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Lower Low pattern confirmed, continuing weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.95x): moderate confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: downtrend, entering weak phase. Potential for further decline if 23,720 KRW support breaks.
